program_overview.title: Canva and AI Design Mastery
program_overview.tagline: Design is a learnable craft, not a talent lottery: principles first, Canva as the instrument, AI as the accelerator, and a portfolio that proves it.
program_overview.description:
Everyone needs design now, for school, clubs, small businesses and every feed, and Canva made the tools accessible; what most people lack is the craft. This live online course for ages 13 and up teaches real design: hierarchy, spacing, color and typography as principles, practiced through hundreds of Canva builds, posters, presentations, social graphics, carousels and short videos, until taste becomes reflex.

The AI layer is taught honestly and age-legally: Canva’s own Magic Studio and Adobe Firefly, tools that genuinely permit teens, used to accelerate ideation, generate imagery ethically and automate the boring parts, with clear credit habits and a plain explanation of why some famous art generators remain 18+. The course ends with a portfolio capstone and a final exam that decides the certificate.

The pace is honest: six months at two live classes a week plus two to three hours of practice, with two more months in hand when needed. Homework after every class, monthly mixed challenges, and a final exam, portfolio review plus a live design task, with a free retest after revision. Real craft, real portfolio, depth over dopamine.

Age-legal AI only: Canva Magic Studio and Adobe Firefly (13+), with honest credit habits and a plain word on why some generators are 18+
Hundreds of real builds: posters, decks, social sets, carousels and short videos, critiqued kindly every week
Brand thinking included: one small real brand built end to end, logo to templates
An honest 6-month arc with 2 months in hand: nobody is rushed
Real assessment: weekly homework, monthly mixed challenges, and a final exam that decides the certificate, with a free retest after revision

faqs.question: What will I actually learn and make in this Canva course?
faqs.answer: More than 100 critiqued pieces across six months: principle drills and poster redesigns, social sets, carousels and presentation decks, a mini brand built end to end, AI-assisted sets using Canva Magic Studio and Adobe Firefly with honest credits, short-form videos, and a capstone campaign presented at demo day with a curated portfolio.

faqs.question: What age is this course for?
faqs.answer: Ages 13 and up, teens through adults, because Canva’s own terms require 13+. Accounts for younger teens are set up together with a parent, and batches are grouped so teens learn with teens and adults with adults where numbers allow.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get genuinely good at design?
faqs.answer: To a portfolio-and-critique level of craft: six months at 2 live classes a week plus 2 to 3 hours of practice, with two more months in hand for learners who want longer. Design is a rep-based skill; the hundreds of critiqued builds are the actual course.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. A design piece follows every class, every month ends with a mixed challenge that revisits earlier skills, and the course ends with a final exam: a portfolio review plus a live design task under friendly time pressure. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: Which AI tools are taught, and are they allowed for teens?
faqs.answer: Canva’s own Magic Studio and Adobe Firefly, both genuinely available at 13+ with consent, used for ideation, imagery and automating the boring parts, always with honest crediting. Several famous art generators remain 18+ by their own terms; the course says so plainly and teaches the age-legal equivalents instead.

faqs.question: Is Canva enough, or do I need Photoshop?
faqs.answer: For the formats this course targets, social, decks, posters, brand kits and short video, Canva is genuinely enough, and the free tier covers the whole syllabus. More importantly, the principles taught here transfer to every tool: a student who owns hierarchy, spacing, color and type can pick up any professional suite later in weeks.

faqs.question: What are the fees?

A mini batch of 3-4 students is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International students pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial class?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo class with no commitment: book at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161. You will design something real inside the demo itself.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups with a real instructor critiquing your actual work, never pre-recorded videos. Design improves through critique, and critique needs eyes on your specific piece.
